_note: Civilian naming and art, ruled 2026-08-25 while reviewing the hero-art pairs. Applied by build-heroes.mjs — a rename lives here, never as a hand-patch on gen/heroes.json, because anything patched onto a generated file dies at the next rebuild. Ids never change; names do. ALL FIVE VARIANT PAIRS ARE RULED as of 2026-08-25: lumberjack v1 · orphan-child v1 · farmer-family v1 (Farmer) · farmer-group v2 (Farmer with a Hat) · school-child v1 (School Child (female), a NEW unit — the plural School Children remains its own).

art._note: Only the SETTLED files are wired — single-version files with no v1/v2 ambiguity. The four pairs below stay unwired until each gets a variant ruling; per gen/art-conventions.json, picking a variant in an undeclared folder is a ruling, not a guess.
